### `lib/src/assistant_dock.dart`

- **class `AssistantDockController`** — The chats the person opened in the dock and which one is shown (§6.11a).
  - `AssistantDockController({ required ImportRead read, required Future<bool> Function(AssistantChatController chat) ask, required void Function(String…` — [read] reads the app's state, [ask] asks the person whether a chat's waiting proposal may go, and [say] shows a transient sentence.
  - `AssistantRequest? get pending` — The open asked last that has not answered, or none.
  - `AssistantChatController? get chat` — The chat shown, or none.
  - `String? get problem` — Why the last open was refused, a safe code shown in the dock, until another choice.
  - `bool isChosen(String tag, AssistantOffer offer)` — Whether [offer] of [tag] is the one chosen — the open asked last, else the chat shown: action ids are unique within a catalog only.
  - `Future<void> choose(AssistantOffer offer, {required String tag})` — Opens [offer] of [tag]'s chat beside the chats held, where it is enabled, else refuses it.
  - `Future<void> switchAssistant(String tag)` — Saves [tag] as the assistant: the chats held stay, each with the assistant it opened with.
  - `void select(String? id, {required String cause})` — Shows the chat [id] — none where null, or where it is not held — for [cause]: `switcher` or `row` (§6.11a).
  - `void pageChosen(Selection? page)` — Shows the chat of the record [page] opens, where it is a chat's record and not the chat shown already: its chat where it is held here, else none — an archived record has no chat to continue (§6.11a, §8.2).
  - `Future<void> close()` — Ends the chat shown on the person's X at the conversation's upper right, asking first where a proposal waits; the press is noted with its cause, the end by its own `session.ended`.
- **class `AssistantDock`** — The assistant beside [child]: who it is, where the person is and what it offers there (§6.11a), at the window's right (§9.1).
  - `const AssistantDock({super.key, required this.child, this.pageMin = Breakpoints.pageMin, this.covered = false})` — Places the dock beside [child], which keeps [pageMin] of width beside the docked panel; [covered] hides the floating portrait while something else stands over the page.
  - `final Widget child` — The page beside the dock: the rail and the page, in the window's frame.
  - `final double pageMin` — The width [child] keeps beside the docked panel, which gives way to it down to its minimum.
  - `final bool covered` — Whether another slide-out stands over the page, under which the portrait does not float.
  - `static const double minWidth` — The docked panel's narrowest, which the page's floor never takes from it.
  - `static const double maxShare` — The docked panel's widest, as a share of the window's width: the page keeps the rest.
